correctness.rationale: Verified prior complete K2q facet classification: 2^q signed-leaf prisms and 2 antipodal cross-polytopes. Each prism is orthogonal product of length sqrt2 segment and simplex; Gram det q+2r(q-r) yields sqrt[2(q+2r(q-r))]/(q-1)!. Exceptional Gram I+11^T/2 yields 2^q/q!*sqrt(1+q/2). Exact binomial E[r(q-r)] yields R_q=2^q(q+2)/(q^3(q+1)), and rational checks for q2..11 plus positive q>=5 ratio prove threshold q=10. With r~Bin(q,1/2), normalized prism area has CLT limit 1-Z²/2 and exceptional facet probability tends to 0; no moment convergence claimed. Independent direct Gram determinant for all 252 sign patterns 2<=q<=7.

They are not a new combinatorial facet classification. Existing exact lattice-normalized volumes make the metric formulas closer to a conversion, reducing independent novelty of individual area values; the area-mass phase and limiting law remain useful, testable secondary conclusions.
